question.worked_solution:
We write the term under the radical as a perfect cube, and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{\frac{{a}^{3}}{(b-1)^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{a}{(b-1)}\cdot \frac{a}{(b-1)}\cdot \frac{a}{(b-1)}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(\frac{a}{b-1})}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{a}{b-1}\end{aligned}
$$
